text: Great to be back with you. Look, I think it means that Washington's influence probably is going to be less than it was, but less leverage shouldn't be taken as zero leverage. And I think that's the case right now, frankly, with Iran, right? That's the exact point that we're seeing at the moment. We're pretty far from a negotiated settlement. My understanding is there's been almost no progress, despite efforts by mediators like the Qataris and the Pakistanis to try and advance some sort of deal. But we're gonna have to wait and see a little bit.
